title: Your Accounting of Disclosures: Frequency, Fee, Period Covered and Exclusions — Medical Records Request (Release of Information)
content:
Under the Medical Records Request (Release of Information) product, Riverbend Regional Health gives the patient an accounting of disclosures of the patient's health information on the terms below.

## Terms, by request type

Column meanings:

- **Free accountings per rolling 12 months**: the number of accountings per rolling 12 months provided without charge.
- **Repeat accounting fee**: the flat fee for an additional accounting inside the same 12 months.
- **Look-back period**: the number of years before the request date that an accounting covers.
- **Repeat fee told in advance**: whether the patient is told of a repeat-accounting fee in advance and may withdraw or narrow the request.

| Request type | Free accountings per rolling 12 months | Repeat accounting fee | Look-back period (years) | Repeat fee told in advance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patient Access - Electronic Copy | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Patient Access - Paper Copy | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Patient-Directed Transmission to a Third Party | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Authorized Release - Attorney or Legal Representative | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Authorized Release - Insurer or Disability Carrier | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Amendment of Health Record Request | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |
| Accounting of Disclosures Request | 1 | $15.00 | 6 | Yes |

## Disclosures not listed in an accounting

On every request type, the following kinds of disclosure are not listed in an accounting:

1. disclosures for treatment, payment and health care operations;
2. disclosures to the patient;
3. disclosures made under the patient's authorization;
4. facility directory disclosures.

## The terms in short

- One accounting in a rolling 12 months comes without charge.
- An additional accounting inside the same 12 months carries a flat fee of $15.00.
- An accounting reaches back 6 years before the request date.
- The patient is told of the $15.00 repeat fee in advance and may withdraw or narrow the request.
